# Contributing: local gate

This repository has no GitHub Actions workflows. The gate is local and runs before any push:

```sh
scripts/ci-local.sh           # unit tests, tools/validate.sh (fleet gate), generated files match HEAD, clean tree
scripts/ci-local.sh --quick   # same without tools/validate.sh
scripts/ci-local.sh --root DIR  # test another checkout (must be the top of an accelerator work tree)
```

- Commit first: the checkout must be clean (untracked files included) before and after the run.
  Every stage runs in a throwaway clone of HEAD, so the gate never rewrites your `README.md` or
  `registry.json`; running `tools/validate.sh` directly still regenerates them in place.

- `README.md` is generated by `tools/gen-readme.py`; edit the generator or `registry.json`, never the README.
- The log goes to `~/.local/state/ci-local/accelerator/latest-<profile>.log` (or `$CI_LOCAL_LOG_DIR`),
  with a JSON summary next to it. The log dir must be yours and not group/other-writable; files are 0600.
  Exit 0 = pass, 1 = a stage failed, 2 = usage or setup error.
- Everything is stdlib Python (`/usr/bin/python3`) and offline.
